Sandbox_BanditsNPC_UIScale_tooltip: Scales the companion dialog/UI window and its text. 1.0 = default. Raise it if the UI looks too small on a high-resolution screen (e.g. 1.25 or 1.5). Reopen the window after changing.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_NPCPortrait3D_tooltip: Show a real head-and-shoulders 3D render of the NPC's face in the V window's profile tab and in conversation. EXPERIMENTAL - this uses the engine's character model widget, which had GPU trouble in an earlier build; test it before relying on it. Off = no portrait.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_NeedsRateMult_tooltip: How fast companion Hunger / Fatigue / Boredom / Hygiene rise. 1.0 = default, 0 = needs never rise.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_NeedsCritical_tooltip: A need at or above this value makes the companion break off to take care of it (if a matching routine spot is assigned).
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_AffinityMult_tooltip: Multiplier on affinity / affection changes from conversation and quests. 1.0 = default.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_ProtectCompanions_too: When on, the player cannot hurt or kill a recruited companion.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_PauseNearPlayer_toolt: When on, neutral wanderers stop and face you when you stand close, so you can talk before they move on.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_CompanionsCloseDoors: Companions close doors behind them at base
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_CompanionsCloseDoors_: When on, a companion who opens a door inside a base area pulls it shut once she is clear of it. Only simple single-leaf doors; double and garage doors are never touched.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_ImmortalCompanions_to: When ON, a recruited companion that would die is instead KNOCKED DOWN - it lies incapacitated until you open the V window and press 'Help up companion'. They still take damage, bleed, and get hungry/tired. Turn OFF for normal mortality (they can die for good). Zombification is a separate option below.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_AllowZombification_to: When ON, a recruited companion that gets bitten builds up infection and eventually TURNS into a zombie, permanently - for players who want that risk. When OFF (default), companions never zombify. Either way, the false zombification bug (companion turning after a reload for no reason) is always prevented.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_InfiniteAmmo_tooltip: When ON, a companion carrying a firearm never runs out: their reserve is quietly topped up so they keep reloading without you handing over magazines. When OFF (default), they only fire what you actually give them.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_CompanionsEnterVehicl: When ON, a following companion hops into your vehicle when you drive off (they board and are safely stowed - not physically seated) and step out next to you when you exit. Works with modded vehicles. This does not require the Bandits mod's own 'may enter vehicles' checkbox.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_RestoreLostCompanions: If PZ's save/load loses a recruited companion, bring it back at its post (Stay tile / Guard spot / where it was). EXPERIMENTAL - it respawns the companion from a saved roster; test it on a backup save first. Off = no auto-restore (duplicates are still cleaned up regardless).
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_WildSpawn_tooltip: How often a lone neutral survivor (recruitable) wanders into the area off-screen. Base Bandits almost never spawns friendly groups, so this fills that gap. Off disables it.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_WildSpawnCap_tooltip: Spawning pauses while at least this many un-recruited neutral survivors are already near you (a LOCAL throttle, not a total limit - explore and you'll keep finding more). 0 = no throttle.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_WildSpawnClan_tooltip: Spawn recruitable companions ONLY from the clan(s) you name here. Enter the clan's name EXACTLY as it appears in the Bandit Creator (the 'Name' field shown when you create or edit a clan, e.g. Survivors). For more than one clan, separate names with commas: Survivors, Recon. Leave EMPTY to use any friendly/companion clan. Names are case-insensitive. (A clickable clan checklist is also available in-game: right-click the ground -> NPC Core Editor -> Spawning tab.)
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_DbgTrace_tooltip: Writes a detailed record of what every companion decides and does to TrueCompanions_trace.txt in the Lua sub-folder of your Zomboid folder (the same place as your saves and Logs). Leave this OFF for normal play - it costs performance and the file grows steadily. Turn it ON only when you are reproducing a bug on purpose, then send the file with your report: it is the difference between a guess and an answer.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_DbgWatchdog_tooltip: ON by default. When a companion holds a walk order but has not moved for about nine seconds her task queue is cleared to force a fresh path, and at about twenty seconds she is stepped directly to her destination. This is what stops a companion standing against a wall forever. Turn it OFF only while bug-hunting: if she still freezes with this off, the freeze is real and the watchdog was only reacting to it - if instead she frees herself, the watchdog was making things worse.
